questions.question: symphony-forge #145 (task scheduler ignores the dependency DAG). The issue proposes two stages: A = DAG-aware frontier (small, safe: a deps-met task can start ahead of an unrelated earlier one; still one active stage at a time), B = intra-story task parallelism in worktrees (union-merging per-task evidence, write-scope disjointness gate, `roadmap parallel --tasks`). What should I take on now?
options: Stage A now as a harness quickfix PR; B as a planned harness story (Recommended)
A and B together in one harness story
questions.chosen: Stage A now as a harness quickfix PR; B as a planned harness story (Recommended)
